title.en: Integration, accumulation, and simple differential equations
title.zh: 积分、累积与简单微分方程

lead.en: Construct definite integrals from finite sums, prove fundamental-theorem connections, normalise nonnegative functions, and diagnose quadrature and Euler simulations against their mathematical models.
lead.zh: 从有限和构造定积分，证明微积分基本定理联系，归一化非负函数，对照模型诊断求积与欧拉模拟。

prerequisites.en: Module 16: derivatives, chain/product rules, mean value theorem and Taylor bounds; Module 15: completeness, continuity and limits. Probability interpretation is introduced cautiously and developed in Modules 21–23.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 16：导数、链积规则、中值与泰勒界；模块 15：完备、连续与极限。概率解释先明确限定，模块 21–23 深入。

en: Distinguish a definite integral, accumulated quantity and family of antiderivatives.
Explain Riemann sums and use the fundamental theorem under continuity hypotheses.
Apply substitution and integration by parts with correct boundaries.
Analyse improper-integral limits and normalise a nonnegative density candidate.
Implement trapezoidal and Simpson quadrature with mesh and smoothness qualifications.
Solve exponential decay, recover equilibrium solutions and diagnose Euler stability, positivity and finite-time error.
zh: 区分定积分、累积量与原函数族。
解释黎曼和并按连续假设使用基本定理。
用正确边界换元与分部积分。
分析反常极限并归一化非负密度候选。
按网格光滑要求实现梯形辛普森。
解指数衰减、补平衡解，诊断欧拉稳定、非负与有限时间误差。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and construct finite sums.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，构造有限和。
阅读定积分与基本定理选段。
检索积分与原函数区别。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and check integration domains.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，检查积分域。

text.en: Compare quadrature errors and smoothness bounds.
text.zh: 比较求积误差与光滑界。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore mesh/step choices.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索网格步长。

text.en: Normalise candidates and compare improper tails.
text.zh: 归一化候选并比较反常尾部。

text.en: Diagnose stable, oscillating and unstable decay steps.
text.zh: 诊断稳定、振荡与不稳定衰减步。

text.en: Complete choices and the written accumulation/dynamics contract.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面累积动力学约定。
阅读反常积分与微分方程选段。

text.en: Complete the exit task and separate model from discretisation.
text.zh: 完成结业并区分模型与离散方法。
